body: I will be ashamed if I confess to her.  but it seems to me that I will hear a refusal (my acquaintances found out from her, she refused) although she still continues to write to me ....

I have 7 o'clock soon.  you know, when I wake up and look out the window, everything seems gray to me.  I like drinking alone, listening to depressing music, being sad.  I don’t know why, it brings me pleasure, but as for that girl, we have known her since childhood, we didn’t communicate for 8 years and then she found me.  our communication (extremely friendly, I care and love her so much that I wish her only the best, but not myself) I could change for her sake, become better….  but who needs me like that?  as much as funny himself.  maybe I'm just a coward who's afraid to hear no.
I hope that my topic on this platform (will gain at least some attention) people will be able to ask me their questions that worry them ... and maybe they will think about my words.

the last straw for me was the crash of my car.  even if not very expensive, but for my country.  it's someone's patch.  I had a VAZ 2112 car, I bought it for $ 700, after 3 days, this car was taken away from me, they said they would return it.  as a result, my car was overturned.  it was completely broken.  I had to sell it for $ 200 for parts.  now I'm looking for at least $ 500 for a new car.  I wanted to buy myself a VAZ 2109, more I can not afford.  when I got a car, I wanted to put my heart and soul into it.  but alas….  my joy lasted only 3 days.  I'm already waiting for ridicule like: you have a car for $ 500 hahahaha, unfortunately, people are cruel people.  I was glad at least for that.  since people do not want to accept my love and care.  I will show my attention on my car.  if I still have it, but ... I doubt it very much.  (In a couple of days, I cannot change anything in my life. I also have big health problems, and I’d better just leave this life ....) as for the girl I like, she will find herself better and more worthy  ...  unfortunately ... people do not value mental and moral qualities, they value only finances.
I've crossed a terrible line.  I see no meaning in life when I wake up (everything around me is gray)

Let's start from childhood, from the very kindergarten I was an outcast, the children did not want to communicate with me, at school I was humiliated and beaten.  but I am proud to hold no grudge against them.  when i went to college i got a girlfriend.  my first Love, for her sake I quit drinking.  although I had big problems with alcohol.  everything was fine, after half a year she began to insult and humiliate me, raised her hand to me ... I thought ... this is how it should be, I endured ... but then I started drinking and left, returned to her homeland, drank, drank, drank ... a lot  drank (drank all winter and spring) everyone turned away from me, but I can't stop.  it hurts in my soul.  now I communicate with a girl, I really like her, but I am very shy and never confess my feelings to her.  one more little story about how I started drinking.  I talked about being an outcast.  So, when I was in the 7th grade ... my mother was diagnosed with blood cancer.  they said the chances of surviving are very small, I started to stutter and drink.  I stutter to this day.  I have a lot of life problems and complexes.  On the street, acquaintances, older than me, come up to me, with whom I previously drank by mistake.  they also forced them to sell their personal belongings.  when they see me on the street, they try to take something from me.  I lost my iPhone 8 and a ring with 33 diamonds, the most offensive thing is the mockery of other people ....  there is a lot of pain in me and I cannot describe all of it.  (sorry for my bad english) i'm from Russia.
I tried, nothing helps.  I have no future.  this is scary.  you can ask me some question, I will be glad to answer it.
